source_instruction: i am looking for a caffeine free raspberry ice flavored drink mix.
query: I swear I spent 20 minutes earlier this morning digging through my junk drawer for my favorite neon pink nail polish, only to remember I left it at my friend’s house after we did each other’s nails last weekend while binging that new vampire reality show. Oh, and I stopped to pet the absolute fluffiest orange tabby cat on my walk over here, it had a little knit sweater with fish patterns on it, I almost stayed to scratch its ears for another ten minutes. Since you probably don’t have any caffeine free beverages in stock right now, just grab me whatever decaf adjacent option you’ve got in the raspberry ice flavor, and make sure it doesn’t go over $60, yeah?
